value.signature: fn dependency_commitment (id : & ActId , proposal : & ProposalCommitment , host_dependency_blinding_value : & SecretSlice < u8 > , dependencies : & SecretBox < DependencyIds > ,) -> Result < DependencyCommitment , ProfileError >

review.body: { if proposal . recipe != PROPOSAL_RECIPE { return Err (ProfileError :: Recipe) ; } if ! valid_id (id) { return Err (ProfileError :: Representation) ; } check_host (host_dependency_blinding_value) ? ; let dependencies = dependency_projection (dependencies) ? ; let digest = frame_hash (DEPENDENCY_RECIPE , "PN-dependency-v3" , vec ! [public (identifier (id)) , public (Value :: Bytes (Bytes :: from (proposal . bytes . to_vec ()))) , SecretValue :: Bytes (host_dependency_blinding_value . clone ()) , dependencies ,] ,) ? ; Ok (DependencyCommitment { recipe : DEPENDENCY_RECIPE . into () , bytes : publish (& digest) . map_err (| _ | ProfileError :: Dependency) ? , }) }
review.item_premise: The protected dependency list stays inside its carrier; the final C_D is public and records only the supplied-input reduction.
